items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: When you first joined Oliver, who was the trombone player? George Fields. ... Yeah, old George Fields.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Did the... When you first joined Oliver, who was the trombone player? George Fields. George Fields. George Fields.
Yeah, old George Fields. He was dead, I think. Mm-hmm. Then we sent and got Ori in California. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
What did Ori play then? He played trombone.
